# Cognimorph

> Cognimorph is a digital agency built by an expert team in Kathmandu, Nepal, and accessible globally. It delivers performance marketing, SEO and AEO, social media, websites and apps, creative production and AI automation. The main client base is in Dubai, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Australia and the United States. First consultations are free. Contact: hello@cognimorph.co

## Services
- [Digital Growth & Performance Marketing](https://cognimorph.co/services#growth): Performance marketing across paid social, search and programmatic; SEO and AEO; social media management; brand and content strategy.
- [Digital Build](https://cognimorph.co/services#build): Websites, mobile and web apps, custom software, maintenance.
- [Creative](https://cognimorph.co/services#creative): Video editing, short-form video, graphic design, CGI, AI video.
- [AI & Automation](https://cognimorph.co/services#ai): Workflow automation, AI agents, AI consulting, team training.

## Company
- [About](https://cognimorph.co/about): Founded in 2024 in Kathmandu, Nepal, with offices in Kathmandu and Dubai. Vision, values and principles. Expert quality at a fair price, built on trust and mutual benefit.
- [Team](https://cognimorph.co/team): Madhav Bhattarai (Co-Founder & Managing Partner: vision, product, strategy, client growth, business development and team management) and Bibesh Shrestha (Co-Founder & Managing Partner: operations, project delivery, team management, client growth and business development) and specialists in each discipline.
- [Work](https://cognimorph.co/work): Risespace (AI productivity app), Hello5.ai (career intelligence), Bilva (fashion in natural thread).
- [Careers](https://cognimorph.co/careers): Disciplines we hire for and how to apply.
- [Contact](https://cognimorph.co/contact): Enquiries and free consultations; replies within one business day.

## Frequently asked questions
